card.name: Partway into drug names, 'dis' and similar
card.fires_on: The 'dis' piece inside drug names like disopyramide and gadoxetate disodium, and some mid-name pieces such as 'yst' in polystyrene. Also a sentence-ending period in Spanish spray directions.

modes.label: Dis inside drug names
modes.description: The 'dis' start of a drug name after a comma or salt name, such as disopyramide or disodium.

modes.label: Other mid-name pieces
modes.description: Middle pieces of long chemical or drug names, such as 'yst' in polystyrene.
